title: Legacy env vars accepted silently with no deprecation log
description: Config::resolve_owner_id() silently falls back from KITHD_OWNER_ID to KITH_OWNER_ID (config.rs:107-109). Config::resolve_data_dir() silently accepts KITH_DB_PATH (config.rs:77-84). No log is emitted when the legacy var is active. If both old and new vars are set with different values, the new var wins silently. A maintainer who sets KITH_OWNER_ID in a systemd unit (thinking it is correct) and also sets KITHD_OWNER_ID in a dotenv file will see the dotenv value win without any indication that the unit file value was ignored. Fix: emit tracing::warn\! when a legacy var is in use: 'KITH_OWNER_ID is deprecated; rename to KITHD_OWNER_ID'. Ideally log this after logging is initialized, not via eprintln.
